title: ProgressionEnchant
description: Fragment/page-based custom enchants—make loot and enchanting exciting again.
body:
# ProgressionEnchant

Vanilla enchanting is usually “done fast”. ProgressionEnchant flips that: enchants feel earned, loot becomes valuable, and progression becomes addictive. Collect fragments/pages, assemble books, and unlock powerful custom enchants that fit your server’s progression.

# Highlights:

Enchant progression via fragments/pages → books → enchants

Perfect for loot tables, dungeons, events, and economy value

Designed for RPG balancing and long-term content

Perfect for: dungeon rewards, RPG loot loops, progression economies.

# Why you’ll love it

Enchants feel earned, not bought and finished in 5 minutes

Loot becomes valuable again (great for dungeons/events)

Adds a long-term collection loop players actually enjoy

# Features

Progression loop: fragments/pages → books → enchants

Custom books and enchant progression

Perfect for loot tables, economy value, dungeon rewards

Designed for balancing (tiers/sets if you use them)

# Setup

Install the plugin

Configure fragments/books/enchants

Add fragments to loot tables (dungeons, mobs, events)

Tune drop rates and crafting costs

# Compatibility

Platform: Paper / Spigot (Paper recommended)

Works best with: Progression, Tools, Shop, Quest, dungeon rewards

Resource pack: optional (only if you use custom models)
